purpose: Compact recorded data for tools/prepare_act_one_departure.py explicit path (departure.json native fields only).

provenance.scope: Opcode21 dispatch slice with explicit eax==esi context produces movie index26/option0, not a control70 operation. Relocated name table gives e125e; unique sphere1/area hash/header binds original318-frame movie and staged conversion frame count. Source level8 entry1 position/flat floor/ceiling are pinned; full native movie pipeline, placement and live route not yet integrated.

limits: opcode21_relocation / name_table_relocation are recorded LE fixup-table lookups; the tool checks the pinned executable bytes of each fixup record, the handler/name targets they imply (0xB5AB5; "e125e"), not the fixup-table walk.

native_argument_cases are recorded results of emulating handler B5AB5..B5AC1 (capstone + CreatureReplay) for three command-record addresses; not re-run. The tool pins the handler bytes (handler_sha256) and checks at byte level that B5AC1 is an E8 call to CF2B4.
Regions, arrival, destination source and the movie binding are NOT carried: they are re-derived from the original L4_HJ/L8_SJ/L4_HJI archives with published readers.
name: e125e
